provenance: Original synthetic teaching inputs. No observed asset prices, investor performance, tax law or market probabilities.

conventions.money: fictional CU; the unit cancels in a return
conventions.period: one year; dates 0, 1 and 2 are equally spaced model years
conventions.dividends: cash paid at each end date; prices are unadjusted ex-dividend prices; immediate reinvestment has no costs or tax
conventions.cash_flow: one nonnegative investor contribution immediately after the date-1 valuation; complete liquidation at date 2
conventions.fees: entry and exit charges on the cash entering and leaving respectively; management fee on post-market assets at each year end
conventions.fx: home CU per one foreign currency unit
conventions.opportunity: one common period; fractional fully invested long-only positions in A and B; no trading costs
conventions.rebalancing: two asset returns per annual interval, no external flows, no fees; rebalance after first-period returns
